brief.text: Closed-end funds feature heavily across both tables, with Saba Capital Management taking positions in DSM, GF, and ECF, while BPRE, SWZ, and PSUS also recorded multiple buyers. BORR generated the largest cluster total by far at $57.1 million across three insiders, whereas FUL stood out for sheer breadth with eight distinct insiders purchasing $1.1 million in shares. Among notable individual trades, Nippon Life Insurance made the largest single outlay with a $17.1 million purchase of CRBG, followed by an $11.5 million buy in IAM by director Evan Lockwood Rachlin.
